name: How long does mobile home exterior paint last?

mainEntity.name: How long does mobile home exterior paint last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of mobile home exterior paint depends on several factors, including the quality of paint used, the thoroughness of surface preparation, the local climate, and the amount of sun exposure. High-quality acrylic latex paints, properly applied to a well-prepped surface, can typically last between 7 to 15 years. In areas with harsh weather or intense UV exposure, such as parts of the Bay Area, paint may need refreshing sooner. Regular cleaning and maintenance can help extend the life of the paint job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior mobile home paint typically lasts 7 to 15 years, depending on paint quality, surface preparation, and local climate.
